design_timing: One development candidate specified after inspecting notebook 10/11 validation errors, before scoring this candidate. Not preregistered or independently validated.
fit_scope: Separate model for each LGA/property; expanding earlier supervised targets, no cross-LGA pooling.

feature_definitions.calendar: Known target Q2/Q3/Q4 indicators; Q1 reference

preprocessing.fit_scope: Only earlier training rows for this LGA and origin; all six inputs standardized.

prediction_rule: last observed rent + 0.5 * predicted quarterly change; no clipping, rounding, deadband or oracle direction selection
damping_rationale: A fixed halfway correction toward the last-observation baseline; an explicit heuristic, not a fitted probability or optimal weight.
selection_policy: Only this new specification is evaluated. No search over alpha, weights, features or per-LGA winners. No score-driven reruns with changed settings.
attribution_limit: Target transformation, historical-change features and damping change together; the comparison does not isolate which change causes an accuracy difference.
aggregation: Equal weight per LGA-quarter; pooled, per-LGA, per-quarter. All 589 validation targets retained.
holdout_policy: 2023Q4-2025Q3 excluded before feature construction, fitting and scoring. These values appeared in prior descriptive EDA; no pristine-blind-test claim.
vintage_limit: Single 2025Q3 workbook; publication lags and revisions not reconstructed. Retrospective period-based evaluation, not a real-time backtest.
deployment_policy: Research only; no current-rent forecast, app change, release change, model pickle, significance claim or automatic promotion.
stopping_rule: Record this candidate once, including a worse result. Stop open-ended validation experimentation and review model-selection readiness before any final-period evaluation.
